rules.cwe_name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: This reports the external APIs that are used with untrusted data, along with how frequently the API is called, and how many unique sources of untrusted data flow to it.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: A statement has no effect

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data to create a template can lead to remote code execution or cross site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Data Processing Errors
rules.description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Document Type Definition
rules.description: Parsing user input as an XML document with external entity expansion is vulnerable to XXE attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Recursive Entity References in DTDs ('XML Entity Expansion')
rules.description: Parsing user input as an XML document with arbitrary internal entity expansion is vulnerable to denial-of-service attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.

rules.cwe_name: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains
rules.description: Disabling or weakening SOP protection may make the application vulnerable to a CORS attack.
